name: text-word-locked-pop
title: Word-locked Sync
description: Mỗi từ bật lên ngay trước lúc nó được nói hay hát, theo mốc thời gian từng từ.

moworks.author: moworks

options.times: s each word is spoken (word timestamps)
options.lead: s the pop comes before the word (0.3; 0.2–0.6)
options.spoken: s a word lasts on the waveform (0.55)
options.wave: waveform bars that light as words are heard (optional)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Each word appears over 250 ms back.out (scale 0 -> 1), starting 0.2-0.6 s before it is spoken (word-level timestamps). Demo: 4 words at 0.3 / 1.1 / 2.0 / 2.9 s, the third in the accent, over a waveform that lights while each word is heard. Params: duration (0.25 s, back.out) · lead: sớm hơn lời (0.2–0.6 s). Take the times from the voice clip's word timestamps.
moworks.titleVi: Chữ bật đúng lúc lời nói
